title: Ashplant
html_source:
An ash sapling; a walking stick. It will go on to feature prominently throughout the novel.

Also a poem by Heaney which is referred to by Heaney in a later poem :
“The dotted line my father’s ashplant made
On Sandymount Strand
Is something else the tide won’t wash away.”
